summary: Multiblock preview rewrite is clean and well-aligned with the DTO contract from Task 6. Text/caption are interpolated only; media bound via :src; FILE :href scheme-guarded via the same regex idiom as FunnelStepForm. Debounce + immediate-first-run preserved, watch correctly moved to a deep watch on step.blocks. Dead single-field code fully removed (grep-clean outside comments). No blocking issues.

findings.finding: mediaLoadFailed is keyed by block index, so a single failed image inside an ALBUM block flips ALL items in that album to the icon fallback (not just the failing item). For non-album media this is exact; for albums it is coarse.
findings.reason: The task explicitly generalizes the old global imageLoadFailed to PER-BLOCK state ('per-block', not per-item). Per-item album fallback is out of scope and a graceful-degradation nicety; current behavior never crashes and shows a neutral icon. Documented in code comments.

findings.finding: Component references i18n keys not yet present in locales: funnels.steps.type.MESSAGE and funnels.editor.previewMediaType.{IMAGE,VIDEO,AUDIO,FILE}. vue-i18n falls back to the key string at runtime (warnings in test stderr).
findings.reason: Task 7 owns i18n/locales/*. These keys are a handoff: Task 7 must add MESSAGE to funnels.steps.type and the previewMediaType.* group to both uk.json and en.json. No CI gate (check-locales) breaks; purely a runtime fallback until Task 7 lands.

findings.finding: The preview store action needed NO source change — it already accepts PreviewStepRequest / returns PreviewStepResponse (types updated by Task 6) and passes the body verbatim; store contract (flip error + re-throw, no useApiError) intact.
findings.reason: Type-driven; only the store preview TEST was migrated to the { stepType, blocks } / { renderedBlocks } shape. Deviation documented in decisions.md.
